Game Overview

At its heart, Fruit King is a puzzle game about become the Fruit King by strategically arranging vibrant fruits in captivating patterns. Engage in addictive puzzle-solving, aiming for high scores to rule the global leaderboard. Plan tactically, predict fruit sequences, and enjoy the colorful challenge that combines strategy and skill for endless fun.
